aggregates.text: SEVEN RINGS AT 100 TO 700 STATUTE MILES

aggregates.text: ONE MARK IS TEN VETERANS, PLACED IN ITS BOROUGH
aggregates.note: A property of the drawing. The mark count per borough is its verified veteran count divided by ten and rounded, and the positions are random inside the borough polygon and are not addresses.
